query:
SELECT 
  p.title,
  p.year,
  CASE WHEN p.seoKeywords IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END as has_seo,
  COUNT(pt.tagId) as tag_count
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
WHERE p.discipline = 'scenic_design'
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.year, p.seoKeywords
ORDER BY p.year DESC, p.title;
